title: Fill column
summary: A column in a parent of fixed height: the fixed slot keeps its height, the rest fills and scrolls.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Fixed region height, a CSS length (12rem). Empty: natural height.

slots.name: fixed
slots.description: Keeps its height above the rest. Empty: hidden.

parts.name: rest
parts.description: The region that fills the rest and scrolls.

a11y: A layout box with no role; reading order is fixed region, then rest.

examples.title: A preview above a scrolling list
examples.html: <pk-fill-column fixed="8rem"><pk-card slot="fixed" heading="Camera preview">Live preview</pk-card><pk-stack><pk-text>Scanned item 1</pk-text><pk-text>Scanned item 2</pk-text><pk-text>Scanned item 3</pk-text></pk-stack></pk-fill-column>
